title: 第2533章 开始布局第2532章 师徒坦白局
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: “师尊，此事暂且搁置吧。算计弟子之人，盘根错节，牵涉甚广，非一时能尽除。弟子不想师尊因此事过早与某些势力彻底对立，陷入被动。”
姜伊人闻言，嘴角却勾起一抹自信而锋利的弧度，轻笑道：
“徒儿，你未免太小看为师了。你以为为师能在造化道院立足，身后当真无人么？放心，此事为师自有分寸。
我会暗中查访，搜集证据，待到时机成熟，定要那些人连本带利吐出来！若真的事不可为，为师也不是那等迂腐莽撞之人，不会与他们硬碰硬。”
方羽看着师尊眼中那份运筹帷幄的自信光芒，心中微暖，知道师尊并非空言，当下不再多劝，微微点头：
“弟子明白，一切有劳师尊。”
三日时光，转瞬即逝。
神战坟场深处，血色残阳如凝固的鲜血泼洒在破碎的苍穹，将亘古不灭的煞气与连绵起伏的残破山峦染成一片凄厉的暗红。
呜咽的阴风卷起带着铁锈味的尘埃，发出如同亡魂低泣般的呼啸。
七道身影悬停于半空，衣袂在狂风中猎猎作响。
为首者，正是方羽。
他身姿挺拔如枪，周身气息沉凝如渊岳，又暗藏锋锐似出鞘神兵。
横炼神主初期巅峰的造化之气与神元神主二重巅峰的神元在体内奔流不息，虽未刻意释放，却已让周遭紊乱的煞气自行退避。
在他身后两侧，风云扬、独孤绝、秦烈、天衍子、玄阙、欧冶洪六人一字排开。
六位神王境强者，即便收敛了大部分威压，那股历经血战磨砺出的凛冽杀气与磅礴力量感，依旧如同无形的风暴中心，搅动着这片古战场的死寂气息。
姜伊人已然离去，返回造化道院处理要务。
此刻，这片凶险莫测的坟场，便只剩下他们七人……以及那四道如同彻底融入虚空阴影，连半步神皇巅峰都无法轻易察觉的幽影四卫。
方羽的目光缓缓扫过下方广袤、狰狞、仿佛被无数神魔鲜血浸泡过的大地，最终落在眼前六位并肩而立的伙伴身上，眼神锐利而坚定。
“你们六人，如今修为已稳固在神王境，根基深厚，战力无双。”
方羽的声音不高，却清晰地穿透呼啸的风声，带着一股掌控全局的沉稳，
“那么接下来，我的布局便可以正式开展了。”
风云扬、独孤绝、秦烈、天衍子、玄阙、欧冶洪六人神色肃然，目光灼灼地聚焦在方羽身上，没有丝毫插话的意图，只有绝对的信任与等待指令的专注。
“我需要你们前往天剑神州，创立剑庭......”
方羽的声音继续响起，清晰地交代着任务细节，每一个字都蕴含着深意。
他将创立剑庭的构想、选址于天剑神州的缘由、以及通知云胤迁移暮雨阁等事项，条分缕析地阐述清楚。
一盏茶的功夫，方羽交代完毕。
他不再多言，右手掌心光芒一闪，一座通体流转着星辰光辉、散发着古老浩瀚气息的微型神殿浮现而出.
正是星辰神殿！
方羽一挥手，星辰神殿便化作一道流光，朝着风云扬稳稳飘去。
“此殿内自成空间，蕴含时间加速之能。我已将造化神碑内所有修行之人，包括我的父母，皆转移至此殿之中。
content_en:
"Master, let's put this matter aside for the time being. The people who are plotting against my disciple are intricately connected and have wide-ranging implications. They cannot be eliminated at once. I don't want my master to completely oppose certain forces prematurely and fall into passivity because of this matter."
When Jiang Yiren heard this, the corners of her mouth curved up with a confident and sharp arc, and she chuckled:
"Disciple, you underestimate my master too much. Do you think that my master can gain a foothold in the Taoist Temple without anyone behind him? Don't worry, my master has his own sense of responsibility in this matter.
I will investigate secretly, collect evidence, and when the time is right, I will make those people spit it out with profits! If something really cannot be done, my teacher is not that pedantic and reckless person and will not confront them head-on. "
Fang Yu looked at the confident light of strategizing in Master's eyes, and felt warm in his heart. He knew that Master was not just talking, so he stopped persuading him and nodded slightly:
"Disciple understands that everything is at your service, Master."
Three days passed in a blink of an eye.
Deep in the God War Cemetery, the bloody setting sun spilled on the broken sky like solidified blood, dyeing the eternal evil spirit and the rolling broken mountains into a sad dark red.
The whimpering wind stirred up rusty dust, whistling like the wails of dead souls.
Seven figures hovered in mid-air, their clothes rustling in the strong wind.
The leader is none other than Fang Yu.
His body is as tall and straight as a spear, his aura is as dense as a mountain, and his hidden edge is as sharp as an unsheathed magic weapon.
The energy of creation at the early stage of the Henglian God Lord and the divine energy at the second level of the Shenyuan God Lord are flowing continuously in the body. Although they are not released deliberately, they have allowed the chaotic evil energy around them to retreat on their own.
Behind him on both sides, Fengyun Yang, Dugu Jue, Qin Lie, Tian Yanzi, Xuan Que, and Ou Yehong were lined up.
Even though the six God King Realm masters had restrained most of their pressure, their murderous aura and sense of majestic power, honed through bloody battles, were still like the center of an invisible storm, stirring up the dead atmosphere of this ancient battlefield.
Jiang Yiren has left and returned to the Creation Taoist Temple to deal with important matters.
At this moment, only the seven of them were left in this dangerous and unpredictable cemetery...and the four shadowy guards who seemed to be completely integrated into the shadow of the void and could not easily detect even half a step to the peak of the God Emperor.
Fang Yu's eyes slowly swept across the vast, ferocious land below, which seemed to be soaked in the blood of countless gods and demons, and finally landed on the six partners standing side by side in front of him, his eyes sharp and firm.
"The six of you have now stabilized your cultivation in the realm of the God King. You have a deep foundation and unparalleled combat power."
Fang Yu's voice was not high, but it clearly penetrated the whistling wind, with a calmness that controlled the overall situation.
"Then, my layout can be officially launched."
Feng Yunyang, Dugujue, Qin Lie, Tian Yanzi, Xuanque, and Ou Yehong looked solemn and focused their gazes on Fang Yu. They had no intention of interrupting, only absolute trust and concentration waiting for instructions.
"I need you to go to the Heavenly Sword State and establish the Sword Court..."
Fang Yu's voice continued to sound, clearly explaining the details of the mission, and every word contained profound meaning.
He elaborated on the idea of ​​establishing Sword Court, the reason for choosing Tianjian Shenzhou, and notifying Yunyin to move Muyu Pavilion.
Fang Yu finished explaining the work of a cup of tea.
He said no more, a light flashed from the palm of his right hand, and a miniature temple with the radiance of stars flowing through it and exuding an ancient and vast aura emerged.
It’s the Star Temple!
Fang Yu waved his hand, and the Star Temple turned into a stream of light, floating steadily towards Fengyun Yang.
"This hall is a self-contained space that contains the ability to accelerate time. I have transferred all the practitioners in the Creation Monument, including my parents, to this hall.
